Use case: stylized-concept. ONE Questing Heroes on-foot directional WALK animation sprite sheet for Bess & Bea.
Image1 is approved IDENTITY portrait. Image2 is LAYOUT and pixel-style reference only; do NOT copy its character.
Identity: INTENTIONAL PAIR of red curly-haired beastmaster caravan guard women, preserve their reference's exact facial species/features, rusty-red and ochre-gold clothes, broad shoulders. Preserve portrait species, face, hair, outfit palette and characteristic props. Infer simple matching lower-body clothes and boots or species-appropriate feet. No horses or new pets.
Layout EXACTLY FOUR columns × FIVE rows equal cells, no gutters, twenty frames total. EXACTLY TWO named partners together in EACH cell, twenty shared frames, forty bodies total. The pair is the hero. Never four partners in one cell.
Each row is FOUR sequential walking frames with visible alternating legs: LEFT contact, passing, RIGHT contact, passing. Props held consistently and continuously joined through hands. Stable scale, feet on SAME baseline at88% cell height.
ROW1 SOUTH directly toward viewer. ROW2 SOUTHEAST down-right. ROW3 EAST right profile. ROW4 NORTHEAST up-right AWAY with back/side visible. ROW5 NORTH directly AWAY, show BACK of head and cape, NO face. Bottom two rows must show back views. Do not repeat front-facing bodies in rear rows. For rolling or flying species use four clear wheel/tail/wing motion phases instead of unnatural human legs.
Full bodies and props entirely within cells with12% transparent padding; face readable at native48×48. Crisp chunky hand-placed PIXEL ART, dark one-pixel outlines, limited24-color palette and flat three-tone shading, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no painterly texture or tiny detail noise.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha backdrop around and between ALL sprites, no white/gray backdrop, checkerboard pattern, shadows, grid, labels, words or numbers. Portrait canvas4:5.
